meta.actionKo: 정맥 혈관의 긴장도를 높여 정맥부전 관련 증상과 치질 관련 징후를 개선합니다.
meta.actionEn: Improves venous tone to relieve symptoms of venous insufficiency and signs related to hemorrhoids.

596b53fd.symEn: Symptoms of venous insufficiency (leg heaviness, pain); adjunctive treatment for disorders from capillary fragility; signs related to hemorrhoids
596b53fd.pointKo: 다리 무거움·통증 등 정맥부전 증상과 치질 관련 징후에 쓰는 디오스민 제제입니다.
596b53fd.pointEn: A diosmin preparation for venous insufficiency symptoms such as leg heaviness and pain, and hemorrhoid-related signs.
